meta_gate.impact_analysis: No result was ever produced under v1 or v2, so no verdict changes and the replay is empty.
meta_gate.independent_review: PENDING. Must be done by a session other than the author of this draft; a human reviewer is preferred.

owner_decisions.decision: No permission is requested from any data provider. The project works with openly available information only and approximates any other needed quantity with its own models.

owner_confirmation_needed: the tightening readings R-05, R-06, R-08, R-09 in changes_from_v2
licence_policy.rule (a source with unverified terms stays out of the primary comparator)
meta_gate.on_approval: Add decision D-128, freeze this file with a pinned SHA-256 in evaluation_protocol_v3.sha256, leave v1 and v2 untouched.

amendment_rule: Once FROZEN this file is never edited. A change is a new file evaluation_protocol_v4.json approved through the D-100 meta-gate.

origin_policy.default: End of a calendar month; only information with a publication time on or before the origin may be used.
origin_policy.spf_alignment: Comparisons with the SPF re-run every model at the survey deadline date published in the SPF documentation, using only data published by then. Month-end origins are never compared with SPF forecasts.

comparison_unit: The object under test is a forecasting method (model, estimation window and procedure), not the truth of a model.

forecast_product.distribution: A precise predictive distribution given as quantiles 5% to 95% in 5% steps, so that proper scoring rules apply.
forecast_product.imprecise_probabilities: Allowed only in the scenario layer; never in a scored forecast.

licence_policy.reason: A benchmark that nobody else can recompute is not a benchmark. The primary comparator must be reproducible from data whose licence allows publishing derived statistics.

statuses.OPEN: Terms verified: public domain or reuse with attribution, publication of derived statistics allowed.
statuses.RESTRICTED: Terms verified: reuse limited (for example personal and educational use only) or publication and derivative works need written permission. Not used by the project at all.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: Terms not found or not read.

licence_policy.no_permissions: The project requests no permission, licence or approval from any data provider. It uses only data whose published terms allow the intended use without asking.
licence_policy.rule: The primary comparator may use only OPEN sources. RESTRICTED sources are not used anywhere in the project (comparator, control arms, criteria, reports). UNVERIFIED sources may be used only as control arms and only after R2 reads their terms and finds them OPEN; they never enter the primary comparator or an admission criterion until OPEN.
licence_policy.approximation: A quantity that is available only through a RESTRICTED or UNVERIFIED source is approximated by the project's own model built from OPEN data (for example OWN_NOWCAST_BRIDGE). An approximation is never presented as equal to the source it replaces and is validated only against OPEN actuals, like any baseline.
licence_policy.resolution: R2 must resolve every UNVERIFIED source to OPEN or RESTRICTED before the comparator composition is recorded; an unresolved source stays excluded.
licence_policy.raw_data: Raw third-party archives are never committed to the repository. They are fetched by script into an ignored directory and the URL, retrieval date and SHA-256 of each file are recorded.

ALFRED_CPIAUCSL.basis: ALFRED series page: public domain, citation requested

ALFRED_OTHER_SERIES.basis: terms are set per series (GDPC1, USREC, yield spread, CPILFESL and others); each must be checked in R2

FRED-MD_FRED-QD.basis: the download page states no terms of use

PHILADELPHIA_FED_SPF_and_RTDSM.basis: terms page not found at the expected address

CLEVELAND_FED_INFLATION_NOWCAST.basis: terms page not found; a suggested citation is given on the data page

ATLANTA_FED_GDPNOW.basis: data file: reproduction for personal and educational use only; site terms: modifying, publishing and creating derivative works are prohibited unless the Bank expressly authorizes them (the terms name the Public Affairs Department as the contact)

gdpnow.use: none: not downloaded, not stored, not scored, not reported
gdpnow.permission_request: NOT PURSUED by owner decision of 2026-11-11
gdpnow.replacement: OWN_NOWCAST_BRIDGE, a nowcast built by the project from OPEN data; the published description of GDPNow-type bridge equations is a method, and implementing a method from public descriptions does not use the archive

targets.note: The series are seasonally adjusted and revised by annual seasonal factors, so first-publication and later actuals differ.
Horizon 0 is the nowcast of the current quarter, reported separately for origins in months 1, 2 and 3 of the quarter.

targets.definition: 1 if at least one month in (t, t+h] is an NBER recession month in the chronology available at evaluation time
targets.note: About eight post-war recessions: low statistical power. Ceiling LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT.

actuals.primary: first publication of the target value
actuals.secondary: value in the vintage available 12 months after the reference period
actuals.rule: Both are always reported, never pooled. T3 uses the NBER chronology as of the evaluation date.

T3.status: PROPOSED parameter change from v2 (180 months); needs the owner's confirmation
T3.reason: A 180-month window contains one or two recessions, so a probit or logit is not identified; the Giacomini-White finite-window requirement still holds.

estimation.reason: Giacomini-White tests require a finite estimation window; a recursive (expanding) window is excluded.

recursive_variant.applies_to: nested model pairs only; reported separately, never counted toward admission

verification_notes.GDPNow: 2011Q3-2014Q1 is the archive tab before the model went live (reconstruction, not a real-time forecast); live forecasts start 2014Q2.
verification_notes.Cleveland_inflation_nowcast: Chart range starts 2013-07; whether the series is an archive of values published in real time is not confirmed (level U).
verification_notes.ALFRED_CPIAUCSL: Vintages dated 1972-07-21 to 1994-02-16 hold only the final 1.5 years of data, so an estimation window of 180 months cannot be built from a single vintage before 1994-02-17.

data_depth.classification_rule: A forecast is REAL_TIME only if every input series comes from the vintage available at the origin; otherwise it is PSEUDO_REAL_TIME. Only REAL_TIME forecasts count toward C1, C2, C4 and C5; PSEUDO_REAL_TIME forecasts are reported separately.
data_depth.first_release_tape: Where one vintage is too short for the estimation window (CPIAUCSL before 1994-02-17), a history assembled from the first publication of each observation in archived vintages counts as REAL_TIME if the assembly method is documented and spot-checked; otherwise the forecast is PSEUDO_REAL_TIME.
data_depth.consequence: DFM_FREDMD is REAL_TIME only from origin 1999-08, so W1 (1990-2006) is mostly pseudo-real-time for it.

alfred_panel.fallback: DFM counts toward admission from 1999-08 only

data_depth.gate: R2 acceptance: reconstruct what was known on a date t for 1990-2026; a spot check of at least 30 (series, date) pairs, with at least 10 of them before 2000, must match the primary-source release of that time, within rounding. Origins in 1990-1999 that fail the check are PSEUDO_REAL_TIME.
vintage_sources: Philadelphia Fed Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists

W3.use: stress report only; contaminated by researcher and LLM knowledge of the episode

forward_registry.use: the only uncontaminated window; the start is the date of the first registry commit, no backdating, and not earlier than the month after the end of W3

baselines.note: Atkeson-Ohanian average of the last four quarters / historical mean; a member for a target only once its sources are OPEN
autoregression, order by BIC, rolling window; a member for a target only once its sources are OPEN
a member for a target only once its sources are OPEN
factors from FRED-MD/QD, number by information criterion; a member only once its sources are OPEN
Estrella-Mishkin yield-curve probit; a member only once its sources are OPEN
Sahm recession indicator converted to a probability by logistic calibration on the rolling window; a member only once its sources are OPEN

SPF median at survey deadlines only; a point forecast, so it enters point losses only; scored only after the definitions are mapped (SPF CPI is q/q and 4Q/4Q, the target is a monthly y/y); a member only once its sources are OPEN
SPF reports the probability of negative quarterly real GDP growth, not an NBER recession; descriptive only

baselines.approximation_of: external GDP nowcasts that the project does not use
baselines.note: the project's own nowcast of the current quarter from OPEN monthly data (bridge equations and a dynamic factor model); horizon 0 only; a member only once its sources are OPEN
NY Fed Staff Nowcast, horizon 0 only; a control arm, used only if R2 finds its terms OPEN; never part of the primary comparator
mean of the point forecasts of the comparator members; the primary comparator for point losses
equal-weight linear pool of the predictive distributions of the comparator members that provide one; the primary comparator for distribution and event losses

primary_comparator_rule: EQUAL_WEIGHT_POINT for point losses and EQUAL_WEIGHT_DENSITY for distribution and event losses. Members: baselines with comparator_member true, scored, REAL_TIME at the origin, and drawn only from OPEN sources (licence_policy). The composition by date is recorded and hashed before any candidate is evaluated; it may change over time as members become REAL_TIME. No selection window. A candidate is also reported against every other scored baseline and control arm.

losses.rule: Every criterion that uses a loss must hold for each loss applicable to the pair; the loss is never chosen after seeing results.

admission.scope: per (target, horizon) pair; a model can be ACTIVE for one pair and not for another

criteria.text: relative loss (candidate/primary comparator) <= threshold on W1 and on W2 separately, for each applicable loss; threshold per admission.threshold_rule

Giacomini-White test with the constant as the only instrument (equivalent to a Diebold-Mariano test with a finite estimation window), HAC with h-1 lags and Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction, one-sided t test, Romano-Wolf adjusted p < 0.10 on W1 and on W2, for each applicable loss; multi-instrument conditional variants are reported only
Model Confidence Set 90% against all scored baselines: membership and set size are reported; short samples make the set wide, so it does not gate

relative loss <= 1.00 in NBER recession months of W1 and W2, and the Giacomini-White test with instruments (constant, recession indicator R_t known at the origin, from the NBER chronology as of the evaluation date) does not reject; reject means p < 0.10 and the statistic favours the comparator; inconclusive if fewer than 12 recession months
not significantly worse than the primary comparator on the secondary actuals
at least 12 resolved forward-registry forecasts for the pair, cumulative relative loss <= 1.00 and empirical interval coverage within 10 percentage points of nominal

threshold_rule.q05_equal_methods: 5th percentile of the relative loss between two statistically equivalent forecasting methods, from the NF-SIM study, computed separately for each (target, horizon, loss)

noise_floor_study.design: Simulate pairs of methods with the same data-generating process and different estimation noise, calibrated on the baselines.
noise_floor_study.sample_sizes: The effective REAL_TIME evaluation length of each (target, horizon, window), after losing h observations and allowing for the h-1 overlap of forecast errors; reference lengths 156 and 204 months, 52 and 68 quarters when every origin is REAL_TIME.

recession_conditioning.instrument: NBER recession indicator R_t known at the origin
recession_conditioning.report: the number of distinct recession episodes behind the recession months

long_horizon.resolved_definition: A forecast is resolved when its target period has been published; it is evaluable at origin + horizon.
long_horizon.independent_outcome: A resolved forecast whose target window does not overlap another counted forecast.
long_horizon.pairs_expected_note: The list is an informal expectation, not a rule; independent_outcome and min_independent_outcomes_for_ACTIVE decide. The target window of T1 is the 12 months of the y/y change, so every T1 horizon yields about one independent outcome a year; T2 has a one-quarter target window, so T2 h=4 can reach the minimum in a few years; T3 uses the interval (t, t+h].

stages.CANDIDATE_to_SHADOW_TEST: C1, C2, C4, C5 on REAL_TIME historical forecasts
stages.LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT_to_ACTIVE: C6 repeated over a second, non-overlapping block, no drift trigger, and long_horizon.min_independent_outcomes_for_ACTIVE met

reporting_requirements: C6: statistical power of the coverage check, which is low with 12 forecasts
composition of the primary comparator by date

multiplicity.registry_of_candidates: Every candidate that was evaluated is recorded, including rejected ones; the count is part of every report. Each COVID variant of a candidate counts as a separate candidate.
multiplicity.primary: Romano-Wolf stepdown, family-wise error rate 0.10. Family: all candidates evaluated for one (target, horizon, loss); a candidate must pass on both W1 and W2.
multiplicity.secondary: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q = 0.10, reported only because candidate losses are dependent.
multiplicity.many_candidates: White Reality Check or Hansen SPA when more than 20 candidates are compared against the same comparator.

model_class_rules.data: Same real-time vintages as every other candidate; a forecast on the latest vintage compared with a baseline trained on older vintages is invalid.
model_class_rules.llm_evidence: A result counts only if it comes from (a) the forward registry, (b) a period after the model's documented knowledge cutoff, or (c) a chronologically consistent model. Any other result is labelled CONTAMINATED and excluded from C1 to C5.
model_class_rules.agent_selection: A model or hypothesis proposed by an LLM agent and selected on historical windows is CONTAMINATED for those windows.
model_class_rules.registry_access: The forward registry is open to every candidate whatever its stage; for a contaminated candidate the only route to admission is the registry and C6.

required_variants: robust outlier handling (Lenza-Primiceri variance scaling or an outlier component in stochastic volatility)
variant with the window excluded from estimation
covid_handling.declaration: The variant is declared when the candidate is registered; it cannot be switched afterwards.
covid_handling.reporting: W3 is reported separately for each variant; W3 never counts toward admission.

forward_registry.cadence: monthly, after the last data release of the month
forward_registry.integrity: committed to the repository before the actual value is published; rows are append-only; a correction is a new row that references the old one

drift_triggers.coverage: interval coverage outside nominal +-15 percentage points over the trailing 24 months
drift_triggers.action: SUSPENDED and review per D-101; automatic rollback only to the previous ACTIVE version

changes_from_v2.summary: Primary comparator uses OPEN sources only; RESTRICTED and UNVERIFIED sources are control arms.
GDPNow is dropped; the NY Fed nowcast becomes a control arm used only if its terms are found OPEN; the project's own OWN_NOWCAST_BRIDGE replaces external nowcasts in the comparator.
Raw archives are never committed; no permission is requested from anyone (owner decision 2026-11-11).
Open information only; quantities available only through restricted sources are approximated by the project's own models and validated against OPEN actuals.
First-release tape for CPIAUCSL before 1994-02-17, documented and spot-checked, else PSEUDO_REAL_TIME.
The R2 gate covers 1990-2026, with at least 10 spot-check pairs before 2000.
NF-SIM uses the effective REAL_TIME length and the h-1 overlap.
Point-only baselines enter point losses; separate point and density comparators; SPF scored only after the definition mapping.
C4 instrument is R_t known at the origin; reject means p < 0.10 and the statistic favours the comparator.
C2 is the constant-instrument Giacomini-White test with a one-sided t test and HLN correction; conditional variants are reported.
Clark-West only for nested pairs.
C2 uses Romano-Wolf adjusted p-values; family defined.
Criteria hold for each applicable loss; q05 per (target, horizon, loss).
T3 estimation window 240 months.
The 180-month window stays for T1 and T2.
Expected-ceiling list corrected; the rule decides.
Report the number of recession episodes.
Report the low power of the C6 coverage check.
The forward registry is open to every candidate.
COVID variant declared at registration and counted as a separate candidate.
Comparator composition recorded by date; W3 ends 2026-10; seasonal revision of CPI noted.
